Hannah Bloom: hi everyone, day two here. quick q — i can open /handbook/templates but the Product PRD template shows 'View only' and there's no Duplicate button. is there a global copy lock? :thinking:
Vikram Desai: welcome Hannah :tada: not global, some templates are intentionally locked. can you paste the PRD link?
Hannah Bloom: sure — https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/templates/product/PRD-v3
docs-rotation: new hires default to viewer role. i've queued adding you to docs-editors. also note we occasionally toggle "Disable duplication" on high-impact pages for stability.
Hannah Bloom: thanks — if duplication is disabled, is it ok to copy/paste the content into a new page as a workaround?
Vikram Desai: try to avoid copy/paste for canonical templates. we keep a lightweight skeleton at /handbook/templates/skeletons/PRD-skeleton you can duplicate. if you need the full copy, we'll flip the page-level copy toggle for your account.
DesignOps: small note — if your PRD will include design assets, use the asset bucket links pattern and add an "Assets:" block with URLs. don't upload large binaries into Notion.
Hannah Bloom: perfect. is there a short onboarding checklist that covers naming, reviewers, and security/PII checks?
OnboardBot: Tip: complete the "New hire docs checklist" at https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/onboarding/new-hire-checklist. Naming convention is `YYYY-MM-team-shorttitle` (e.g., 2026-04-product-checkout-PRD). Include an "Owner:" line at top.
Hannah Bloom: good to know. one more — when i move a draft into /handbook/drafts and open a PR in the docs repo, does CI run automatically?
docs-rotation: yes — open a short PR linking the Notion draft. CI runs link-checker + style-lint and flags missing sections. tag 1-2 reviewers in Notion page comments for inline feedback.
Hannah Bloom: got it, thanks everyone! :raised_hands: if i hit any permission snags i'll re-ping docs-rotation.
